variants.when: 9-5 (about 1999–2004) with the service message on the SID display
steps: Reset only after the service, including the oil and filter change, has been done.
Turn the ignition on so the service message is showing on the SID. It can only be cleared while it is showing.
Press and hold the CLR (CLEAR) button for at least 8 seconds.
Let go once the beep confirms the reset.

variants.when: 9-3 using the SET and CLR buttons (2008) or the CUSTOMIZE button and INFO dial (2006)
steps: Reset only after the service, including the oil and filter change, has been done.
Turn the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
SET-button cars: hold SET until a tone sounds, scroll to Time for Service, press SET and choose YES.
CUSTOMIZE-button cars: press CUSTOMIZE, then use the INFO dial to choose System Settings, Service Info and Reset Service Ind., and confirm Yes.
Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
With the ignition on, press the fuel button on the Driver Information Center until ENGINE OIL LIFE shows.
Hold the select button for about five seconds until OIL LIFE RESET appears.
If the change engine oil light comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.

notes: Saab's service reminder is reset by the driver from the SID or the settings menu, and only after the service is done. The 9-7X uses GM's oil life system, and the 9-2X is closely related to the Subaru Impreza.
